label: kizuna_botan_c_01
text: H-how you doing, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]?[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: kizuna_botan_c_02
text: I’ve never been inside the art room before.\nIt smells like paint in here—but in a good way.[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: kizuna_botan_c_select_01
text: Something up?

label: kizuna_botan_c_select_02
text: What brings you here?

label: kizuna_botan_c_04
text: I’m worried about this rumor that’s going round.\c\nPeople are saying Team Star’s planning to raid\nthe art room or something.[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: kizuna_botan_c_05
text: It’s probably just rubbish made up by some kids\nwho are still scared of Team Star though.[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: kizuna_botan_c_06
text: My friends would never do anything like that.\nAnd who’d want to raid the art room, anyway?[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: kizuna_botan_c_hono_01
text: Knock knock! We’re comin’ in!!![VAR 0x0114(001F)]

label: kizuna_botan_c_07
text: GAH! They actually showed up?![VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: kizuna_botan_c_kakutou_01
text: Wow, this Staraptor is incredible! It looks just like\nit’s about to attack with Close Combat![VAR 0x0114(0022)]

label: kizuna_botan_c_hono_02
text: Hey. You with the art club or what?[VAR 0x0114(001F)]

label: kizuna_botan_c_student_01
text: Uh, y-yeah, I am...?

label: kizuna_botan_c_08
text: Don’t tell me that rumor was for real! Are they\nactually gonna raid the art room?![VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: kizuna_botan_c_09
text: N-no, there’s no way. They wouldn’t. We should\njust keep watching...[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: kizuna_botan_c_student_02
text: So, um, did...did you need anything?

label: kizuna_botan_c_hono_04
text: Um, yeah. I, uh...I’m here to ask...you know...if...[VAR 0x0114(001F)]

label: kizuna_botan_c_hono_05
text: IF YOU GOT ANY LAST WORDS, PUNK![VAR 0x0114(001F)]

label: kizuna_botan_c_10
text: No WAY! It’s a raid! This is literally a RAID![VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: kizuna_botan_c_kakutou_02
text: Oh, knock it off, Mellie![VAR 0x0114(0022)]

label: kizuna_botan_c_kakutou_03
text: Being shy is one thing, but you can’t go around\nthreatening people to cover it up![VAR 0x0114(0022)]

label: kizuna_botan_c_hono_06
text: R-right, sorry, Eri. My bad...[VAR 0x0114(001F)]

label: kizuna_botan_c_hono_07
text: So, uh...about your club. The art club, I mean.\nI, um...I was wondering if...I...could join...[VAR 0x0114(001F)]

label: kizuna_botan_c_student_04
text: Oh! You wanted to ask about club membership!\nSheesh, you had me scared there!

label: kizuna_botan_c_student_05
text: We’re open to any students who want to join.\nBut, uhhh...

label: kizuna_botan_c_kakutou_04
text: Yes! Isn’t that great, Mellie?[VAR 0x0114(0022)]

label: kizuna_botan_c_hono_08
text: Hang on, Eri. This guy’s still got somethin’ to say.\c\nSpit it out, then. I gotta earn my way in or what?[VAR 0x0114(001F)]

label: kizuna_botan_c_student_06
text: Ah, no, it’s just— I was hoping I could ask what\nprompted you to go for the art club, that’s all.

label: kizuna_botan_c_hono_09
text: You’re askin’ me why I wanna join? Well, if I\ngotta explain...[VAR 0x0114(001F)]

label: kizuna_botan_c_hono_10
text: One of my pals made this outfit for me.\nThese sick boots and everythin’.[VAR 0x0114(001F)]

label: kizuna_botan_c_hono_11
text: I’m big into flame patterns like this, so...I wanna\ntry and make somethin’ like it myself.[VAR 0x0114(001F)]

label: kizuna_botan_c_hono_12
text: So. Yeah. PAINTING! That’s what I wanna do![VAR 0x0114(001F)]

label: kizuna_botan_c_hono_13
text: I’m a total newbie at it, but...[VAR 0x0114(001F)]

label: kizuna_botan_c_hono_14
text:
I realized somethin’ when I saw that real simple-
lookin’ Fletchling painting on the wall there.\c
I don’t hafta be some genius artist. I just wanna
make art that has its own charm, y’know?[VAR 0x0114(001F)]

label: kizuna_botan_c_student_07
text: The Fletchling painting? Um...I did that one.

label: kizuna_botan_c_hono_15
text: That one’s YOURS?! I thought it was, like, a\nfinger painting by a kindergartener or something![VAR 0x0114(001F)]

label: kizuna_botan_c_student_08
text: Ha ha! Yeah, I get that all the time.

label: kizuna_botan_c_mobs_01
text: Our president’s paintings are real lovable ’cause\nthey’re real simple! Everyone says so!

label: kizuna_botan_c_hono_16
text: HUH? You’re the art club’s PRESIDENT?[VAR 0x0114(001F)]

label: kizuna_botan_c_mobs_02
text: I can already tell we’ll have a lot of fun in the\nclub together! Could you tell us your name?

label: kizuna_botan_c_mobs_03
text: Your boots are awesome! Can I get a closer look?

label: kizuna_botan_c_hono_17
text: Th-the name’s Mela... And yeah, good eye!\nMy boots are the best. A pal of mine who’s a\r\nbig arts-and-crafts nerd made them for me.[VAR 0x0114(001F)]

label: kizuna_botan_c_11
text: So the raid thing was just a misunderstanding...\c\nWell, that’s a relief. But wow...I didn’t know that\nMellie wanted to join the art club.[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: kizuna_botan_c_kakutou_05
text: I can’t wait to see what Mellie paints! I bet it’ll be\nsomething amazing, huh?[VAR 0x0114(0022)]

label: kizuna_botan_c_12
text: Yeah, I guess...[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: kizuna_botan_c_13
text: GAH! Eri?! How’d you know we were here?![VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: kizuna_botan_c_kakutou_06
text: Wait, were you supposed to be hiding?\c\nI was wondering what was going on—you were\njust kinda hanging out in the open over here...[VAR 0x0114(0022)]

label: kizuna_botan_c_kakutou_07
text: But you don’t need to worry anyway. Mellie’s\nbeen too nervous to notice you.[VAR 0x0114(0022)]

label: kizuna_botan_c_14
text: Wow. So even Mellie gets the jitters sometimes.[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: kizuna_botan_c_kakutou_08
text: Trying new things is scary for everyone.\nThat’s why I came with her for moral support.\r\nBut you know? I think she’ll be just fine.[VAR 0x0114(0022)]

label: kizuna_botan_c_kakutou_09
text: And she’s not the only one doing something new!\nCarmen and I have started up a wrestling club.[VAR 0x0114(0022)]

label: kizuna_botan_c_kakutou_10
text: Mellie will have a blast here, I’m sure, so I gotta\nkeep up with her! I’ll enjoy the time I have left at\r\nthe academy as much as I can![VAR 0x0114(0022)]

label: kizuna_botan_c_kakutou_11
text: Anyway, it was nice bumping into you both!\nHasta la vistar! ☆[VAR 0x0114(0022)]

label: kizuna_botan_c_16
text: Mellie and Eri really are putting themselves out\nthere, aren’t they.[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: kizuna_botan_c_17
text: I...I guess I’ll head off, too. Hasta la vistar... ☆[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
